text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin has survived her debut<n>race. Even after
crossing the finish<n>line, her excitement shows no
signs<n>of dying down, and her heart races<n>wildly.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The pounding in Ines Fujin's chest<n>takes her back
to a moment in which<n>she felt profoundly inspired
by the<n>Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Reminded of that time, she sets her<n>sights on
winning the Japanese<n>Derby herself. She knows it
might<n>seem like a rash decision, but Ines<n>Fujin
wants what she wants!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
To prepare ourselves for this bold<n>goal, we decide
to take on a G1 race<n>that's host to a gathering of
fierce<n>junior-year racers. It's settled—our<n>next goal
is the Asahi Hai Futurity<n>Stakes!
